policy_presence.summary: McGill's Code of Student Conduct (Nov 2025) contains AI-specific offences, alongside Provost-endorsed principles.

coursework.summary: Use only as authorized by the instructor/supervisor and course requirements; no university-wide default.

exams.summary: Unauthorized AI or disallowed tools in an assessment are offences under Articles 25(b) and 26(f).

ai_disclosure.summary: Students acknowledge AI use where applicable per instructor expectations; thesis GenAI statement recommended, not yet mandatory.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Remove PII; no PHI, PCI or confidential data even in secure Copilot.

academic_integrity.summary: Code offences; detector output alone insufficient; balance of probabilities; Advisor right.

approved_tools.summary: Secure Copilot for McGill work; unreviewed tools prohibited for McGill purposes; directory login-restricted.

named_ai_services.summary: Copilot (secure version) and DeepL Pro for translation; free/public versions prohibited.

teaching_guidance.summary: Instructors should state AI rules in course outlines; detectors not supported.

research_guidance.summary: GPS three-tier risk guidance; thesis disclosure recommended from May 2026.

security_procurement.summary: New AI tools, AI features and sensitive-data requests go through the AI Review Committee.
